text.title: AI Pairing Decision Tree Decision Tree
text.summary: Routes the task on the same four axes the record carries — stakes from blast radius, reversibility, novelty proven by precedent, and supervision budget against the expected diff — to the rule that caps the admissible mode.

decision-tree.root-question: Is this a change that will be committed, with the mode genuinely open — not a throwaway script, not IDE-template or codegen boilerplate, and not already fixed by a standing repository policy?

branch.when: throwaway script with no commit, pure scaffold/codegen/formatter output, or a standing policy already fixes the mode for this class of change

conclusion.verdict: skip the record; take whatever is fastest, or apply the policy and cite it — per-task records that all say the same thing train the operator to stop reading them

branch.when: a committed change with the mode still to be chosen
branch.question: Can stakes be named from observables — rows or tables written, customer-facing endpoints touched, money moved, credentials or PII read, blast radius if wrong?

branch.when: no; the only available ranking is how hard the task feels or how close the deadline is

conclusion.verdict: halt and re-derive stakes from a named observable before routing; scoring by effort sends the one-line CIDR change to the least supervised mode

branch.when: yes; blast radius is nameable and recorded
branch.question: Does a revert need a data restore or an external counterparty — and if not, is there an in-repo precedent at path:line and a blocking CI gate that runs without the operator?

branch.when: revert needs a data restore or an external counterparty: destructive migration, hard delete, payment capture or refund, outbound mail or push to real users, key rotation, DNS/TLS cutover, IAM widening, package release

conclusion.verdict: route to solo or ai-pair with pre-merge human diff review; full-agent is unavailable regardless of the other three axes

branch.when: reversible by git revert, but search finds no in-repo precedent, or the task adds a new external dependency or calls an internal undocumented API

conclusion.verdict: set novelty=novel-pattern; full-agent is unavailable — invented package and helper names fail at import or runtime, not at review

branch.when: reversible with a cited precedent, but no named test, type-check and lint gate blocks the merge without the operator

conclusion.verdict: route to ai-pair until the gate exists and is wired into CI; without it the verdict is not delegated-with-a-net but unreviewed

branch.when: reversible, precedent cited, gate wired — but the expected diff runs well past ~200-400 changed lines for one review sitting

conclusion.verdict: split into separately reviewable commits or route to ai-pair; past the rate ceiling the diff is nominally reviewed and empirically skimmed

branch.when: reversible, precedent cited, gate wired, diff fits one sitting — but the session has already started or the mode is being changed mid-task

conclusion.verdict: do not backfill; emit a NEW record referencing the previous artefact_id and never edit the original verdict, since the fallback is the signal worth keeping

branch.when: reversible, precedent cited, gate wired, diff fits one sitting, and no prompt has been sent yet

conclusion.verdict: apply the full methodology; write the record with all four axes and their evidence, then start the session in the verdict's mode
